translationRepairs: In the seventh year he was appointed right vice censor-in-chief of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat.
In the seventh year he was appointed right vice councilor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat.
Chinese 岭北行省右丞 is a Branch Secretariat vice councilor (右丞), not a censorate post (御史).
In the seventh year he was appointed right vice censor-in-chief of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat.
In the seventh year he was appointed right vice councilor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat.
Same office mistranslation as in the idiomatic field: 右丞 is not censor-in-chief.

In the first year of Zhishun he was transferred to intendant of the Upper Capital, wore the tiger tally of the Yuan descent, became commander-in-chief of the Tiger-Gallant personal army, was advanced to grand preceptor with protocol equal to the three dukes, directed the Lingbei Branch Privy Council, was enfeoffed as prince of Xuanding commandery, and was granted a golden seal.

In the first year of Zhishun he was transferred to intendant of the Upper Capital, wore the tiger tally of the Yuan descent, became commander-in-chief of the Tiger-Gallant personal army, was advanced to grand preceptor with protocol equal to the three dukes, directed the Lingbei Branch Privy Council, was enfeoffed as prince of Xuanning commandery, and was granted a golden seal.
宣宁 is Xuanning, not Xuanding.
Under the old regulations commoners were recruited to deliver grain inland to supply the frontier; that year thirty thousand piculs qualified.
Under the old regulations commoners were recruited to deliver grain inland to supply the frontier; that year three hundred thousand piculs qualified.
Chinese 三十万石 is 300,000 piculs, not 30,000.
